quarterly_data.quarter: Jazz Pharmaceuticals press release: Jazz Pharmaceuticals to Acquire Actio Biosciences, (08-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Jazz agreed to acquire privately-held Actio Biosciences, adding ABS-1230, a clinical-stage oral small-molecule KCNT1 ion channel inhibitor for KCNT1+ epilepsy, a rare genetic developmental and epileptic encephalopathy affecting approximately 2,500 patients in the United States with no FDA-approved therapy. ABS-1230 showed meaningful seizure reductions in an early proof-of-concept trial; the ongoing Phase 1b/2a KYRON trial is designed to serve as the registrational study for a U.S. NDA, and the asset holds FDA Fast Track, Rare Pediatric Disease and Orphan Drug designations and was accepted into the FDA's Rare Disease Evidence Principles (RDEP) program. Actio's other programs (including TRPV4 inhibitor ABS-0871) spin out into a new private company in which Jazz takes a minority stake. Closing was expected by the fourth quarter of 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: approximately 2,500 U.S. KCNT1+ epilepsy patients; Phase 1b/2a KYRON registrational trial; close expected by fourth quarter of 2026
